content.text:
The broker that allows multiple processes to share one physical CAN bus is implemented in `src/agentic_hil/canbroker.py`, in the `CanBroker` class (with its `main()` CLI entrypoint, `agentic-hil-can-broker`).

As the module docstring explains: "One process owns one physical CAN bus; named participants share it." The broker takes the exclusive `can:<adapter>:<channel>` bus lock (via `BenchMutex`) and holds it for its lifetime, then lets multiple named participants attach to logical locks (`<bus-key>#<name>`) so several processes/runs can share the single physical bus concurrently without directly contending for the OS-level device lock. Configuration for which buses are shared and their participant "shares" is defined via `CanShareConfig` in `src/agentic_hil/types.py`.
